description: This file defines the NodeRevisionRevertForm class in Drupal, providing a form for reverting node revisions within the Drupal content management system.

classes.name: NodeRevisionRevertForm
classes.description: A form class for reverting node revisions in Drupal, extending ConfirmFormBase to handle user confirmation and revision reversion logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting node storage, date formatter, and time services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question asking if the user wants to revert to a specific revision date.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL to return to the node's version history.

methods.name: getConfirmText
methods.description: Returns the text for the confirmation button.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, setting the revision to revert.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission to revert the node revision, update revision info, log, and redirect.

methods.name: prepareRevertedRevision
methods.description: Prepares a revision for reversion by creating a new revision from the existing one.
